summary: Sony Group Corp filed a Form 6-K disclosing the monthly status of its ongoing share repurchase program. During August 2026, Sony repurchased 11,613,200 shares for ¥43,476,052,881 through open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The repurchases are authorized under a board resolution dated May 8, 2026, allowing up to 230 million shares (3.89% of outstanding) or ¥500 billion, over a one-year period through May 10, 2027. As of August 31, 2026, cumulative repurchases totaled 67,581,300 shares for ¥237,352,140,305. The program reduces share count and returns capital to shareholders.
